_doc: Experience and levels inside one run (rules/experience.gd, #162). Every fight you finish gives experience, and the way it ended does not matter: slain, spared, won over or sent on its way all teach the same. Backing out of a fight teaches nothing, so a monster can't be farmed by walking away and back. A champion gives its bonus on top. `levels` is how much experience each level takes, level 1 first, so a run can reach no more levels than it lists. `gain` is what a level adds: `max_hp` and the `heal` that comes with it, and `edge` to every strike that lands, given at the second level and every `edge_every` levels after it (2, 4, 6 ... with 2).
